_comment: Copy to config.json and make it yours. Salary floors and profile details are blanked here on purpose - config.json itself is gitignored so your real numbers never leave your machine. Edit this file to retune the search without touching code. Restart the server after editing, or hit POST /api/config/reload.
_calibration_note: Bands as specified put most genuinely-good postings at 80+. After ~20 rows, if more than a third land in Strong, raise the thresholds (e.g. Strong 88, Worth a shot 76, Stretch 62) and click 'Re-score all'. Harsh bands are the point.
_fx_comment: Rough units of currency per 1 USD. Used only to compute a comparable USD figure for sorting/analytics. Update when you care.

bands.label: Strong
bands.action: Apply this week. Tailor the CV. Chase a referral.

bands.label: Stretch
bands.action: Apply only if the company genuinely interests you.

bands.label: Do not apply
bands.action: Drop it unless it signals a market trend.

hard_excludes: pure saas pm with no hardware/ai/platform angle
fintech / insurtech / ecommerce / marketplace domain-depth roles
roles requiring 5+ yrs in a domain with zero exposure
staffing-agency bench roles with no named end client

linkedin._comment: LinkedIn discovery via Apify. Token lives in .env (APIFY_TOKEN=...), never here. Each query runs in every location. Cost ~USD 1 per 1000 results on the default actor.
linkedin._experience_levels: LinkedIn f_E codes: 4 Mid-Senior, 5 Director, 6 Executive

queries.keywords: ("Group Product Manager" OR "Lead Product Manager" OR "Principal Product Manager" OR "Product Lead") AND (robotics OR AMR OR "autonomous mobile" OR "industrial automation" OR "warehouse automation" OR "autonomous systems")
("Edge AI" OR "Physical AI" OR "Embodied AI" OR "Edge Robotics" OR "AI Lab") AND (Lead OR Head OR Manager OR Architect OR Principal)
(robotics OR "edge computing" OR "hardware-software integration") AND ("Technical Lead" OR "Solution Lead" OR "Innovation Lead" OR "Head of Robotics")
("Head of Product" OR "Director of Product" OR "VP Product") AND (hardware OR IoT OR robotics OR "connected devices" OR appliances)
("Principal Product Manager" OR "Staff Product Manager" OR "Group Product Manager" OR "Lead Product Manager") AND (AI OR "machine learning" OR platform OR agentic)
(CTO OR CPO OR "Chief Product Officer" OR "Chief Technology Officer") AND (robotics OR hardware OR deeptech OR IoT)
("Engineering Manager" OR "Head of Embedded" OR "Embedded Systems Manager" OR "Head of Firmware") AND (embedded OR firmware)
("Head of Programmes" OR "Program Director" OR "Head of Programs") AND (incubator OR accelerator OR deeptech OR "innovation hub")

_favourites_comment: Roles you marked as the right kind of job. Every posting gets an affinity sub-score (0-10) for how much it resembles these; the rest of the rubric is scaled to 90 so the total stays /100. Star more roles in the app and they are added automatically (stored in the database).

favourite_roles.why: Replace with a role that is the kind of job you actually want. Every posting gets scored on how much it resembles these, so be specific.

indeed._comment: Indeed discovery via Apify (curious_coder/indeed-scraper). Token lives in .env (APIFY_TOKEN=...), shared with LinkedIn. This actor takes one query+location per run, so a sync fans out into #queries x #locations small runs instead of one batched run. Cost ~USD 0.0001/result plus a small per-run start fee.

queries.query: "Group Product Manager" OR "Head of Product" robotics OR AMR OR IoT OR "connected devices"
"Edge AI" OR "Physical AI" OR "AI Lab" lead OR head OR manager
"Engineering Manager" embedded OR firmware OR robotics
"Principal Product Manager" AI OR "machine learning" OR platform

naukri._comment: Naukri discovery via Apify (muhammetakkurtt/naukri-job-scraper). Token lives in .env (APIFY_TOKEN=...), shared with LinkedIn/Indeed. Naukri.com (India) searches are built as direct naukri.com/<keyword>-jobs-in-<city> URLs; Gulf searches go through NaukriGulf via jobBoard+location instead (city codes there aren't slug-based). Cost well under USD 0.01 per search.

queries.keyword: edge ai physical ai lab lead

instahyre._comment: Instahyre discovery via Apify (getascraper/instahyre-jobs-scraper). India-only, curated tech jobs. Keywords x locations are both arrays the actor searches in a SINGLE call (unlike Indeed/Naukri/Wellfound, no fan-out needed here). Cheap: ~USD 0.0011/job including details.

wellfound._comment: Wellfound/AngelList discovery via Apify (orgupdate/wellfound-jobs-scraper) - startup-heavy, relevant to the founder/deep-tech archetypes (C/E). One location per run (fanned out like Indeed/Naukri, same 3-concurrent throttle). No actor-side keyword filter applied - the comma-keyword field's AND/OR semantics for multi-archetype search are unclear, so this relies on the tracker's own archetype/title classification against a broad per-location pull instead, same approach that worked well for Naukri.
